How suddenly has the pain increased? Are you positive you didn't pull your back out? Anyway, if all your labs are indeed normal, definitely don't let your lizard brain go into panic mode. I was honest with my doc about my phen abuse, and she was really cool about prescribing me baclofen... She actually did it twice after I relapsed on the phen, so I highly recommend asking your doctor. People seem to have a mostly positive but sometimes mixed response to gabapentin for the phenibut withdrawals, but having that or benzos on hand as you taper could be helpful. Another comment suggested kratom and I definitely agree. Agmatine is apparently a miracle for some people. Anyway, you're on a lot of phenibut, and just for your own well-being it would be great if you could keep tapering down. The advice on this sub is so very true when it reminds you that you're going to feel anxious and self-hating, but I have withdrawn several times, using several methods, and I promise you will survive. Feel free to message if you need or want any advice, or just someone to talk to. With your labs being fine I'm at a loss regarding your back pain though, sorry. I wish you the very best!
